fields.statement: QA cycle 2, built binary in a scratch root with a fake rex that runs commands: run start --workflow plan --new 'Ship v3' --milestone --autonomous (with and without --dry-run) and run start --autonomous on a record change set each exit 2 with 'workflow plan-milestone (builtin:plan-milestone) declares the plan stage owner', no draft and no .git/rhiza/runs; the record start without --autonomous runs plan-milestone; an intention plan with --autonomous succeeds with autonomous true; a repo plan-milestone.toml with autonomous = false refuses naming the repo file; run resume of that run, edited to be journaled autonomous, exits 2 naming 'as run ... journaled it'; a repo plan-milestone.toml with autonomous = true lets the milestone --autonomous start succeed.

QA cycle 2, built binary: workflow ls lists 'plan-milestone builtin builtin:plan-milestone'; a record change set's plan run journals workflow plan-milestone; rhiza daemon --once on a queued milestone request with rhiza.autonomy.plan auto detaches 'run start --foreground --workflow plan-milestone --pick default ... --milestone' with no --autonomous (RHIZA_TEST_DETACH_LOG); a repo plan-milestone.toml declaring autonomous = true makes the run autonomous.

QA cycle 2, built binary: a repo plan.toml with [autonomy] plan = 'auto' loads and runs; workflow check plan exits 1 for each bad file: both autonomous and [autonomy] ('autonomous and [autonomy] are both set'), autonomy.build ('unknown stage; want plan, accept, ship, signoff'), plan = 'yes' ('yes is not a mode; want "auto" or "owner"'), autonomous = 'auto' ('auto is not a boolean'); run start with the bad file is refused with the same message.

QA cycle 2, built binary: a plan run whose repo plan.toml declares only plan = auto, with rhiza.autonomy.accept owner, shows in run status 'Autonomy plan: auto from workflow plan', 'Autonomy accept: owner from rhiza.autonomy.accept', and ship/signoff from their settings; the journal's started entry carries an autonomy array of stage, mode, source and workflow; a plan-milestone run shows all four owner from workflow plan-milestone.

QA cycle 2, built binary: rhiza health's autonomy part lists the four settings, then 'workflow plan-milestone (builtin:plan-milestone): plan owner, accept owner, ship owner, signoff owner' with no repo declaration, and 'workflow plan-milestone (.rhiza/workflows/plan-milestone.toml): plan auto, ...' once a repo override declares autonomous = true.

QA cycle 2, built binary, plan stage: with rhiza.autonomy.plan owner and a repo plan.toml declaring autonomous = true, rhiza daemon --once on a feature request detaches 'run start --foreground --workflow plan --pick default --new Add exports ... --autonomous'; a milestone request with the setting auto starts plan-milestone without --autonomous. The ship and signoff stages were checked only through their testscripts (workflow-stage-autonomy, daemon-root-ship-workflow), which pass.
